title: Motion for an extension of time to file respondent's brief on the merits

pages.text:
Gupta Wessler LLP
235 Montgomery Street, Suite 629, San Francisco, CA 94104
P 415 573 0336     F 202 888 7792
guptawessler.com

January 6, 2026

Via Electronic Filing

Hon. Scott S. Harris
Clerk of the Court
Supreme Court of the United States
One First Street, NE
Washington, DC 20543










Re: No. 24-935, Flowers Foods, Inc. et al. v. Brock
 Amended Extension Request

Dear Mr. Harris:

 I am counsel of record for the respondent in this case. Having conferred with counsel for
the petitioners, I respectfully request that the Court extend the deadline for Angelo Brock to
file his response brief on the merits by ten days, to and including January 22, 2026. The
respondent’s brief is currently due on January 12, 2026. Counsel for the petitioners consents to
this request, as long as the Court grants the petitioners’ forthcoming application to extend their
reply brief deadline by ten days, to and including March 3, 2026.
 There is good cause for this extension because I was prevented from working on the brief
for more than a week due to an illness, and my colleagues and I have several intervening
obligations that would make it difficult to prepare the response brief absent the extension.
These obligations include, for example: a petition for rehearing en banc due in the D.C. Circuit
in Wilcox v. Trump, No. 25-5057, on January 5, 2026; an oral argument in the Ninth Circuit in
People of the State of California v. Meta Platforms, Inc., No. 24 -7037, on January 6, 2026; an
oral argument in the Federal Circuit in NVLSP v. United States, No. 24 -1757, on January 7,
2026; a response brief due in the Ninth Circuit in Uhl v. Roblox Corp., No. 25-5057, on January
20, 2026; and an opening brief due in the Fourth Circuit in Does v. Hammy Media Ltd., No. 25-
2411, on January 20, 2026.
 This schedule would permit this case to be heard during the Court’s March sitting. The
petitioners’ reply brief would be due on or before March 3, 2026, and would therefore be
received by the Clerk more than 10 days before the beginning of that sitting on March 23, 2026.

       Sincerely,

       /s/ Jennifer D. Bennett
Jennifer D. Bennett
       Counsel for Respondent
